# MultipleReturnStatements

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" />

Group: [Architecture](/rules/#architecture) · PhpStorm name: `MultipleReturnStatementsInspection`

A method with many exit points is harder to follow than one with a single
result path. The rule counts `return` statements per method and reports it
above two configurable thresholds (a normal one and a severe one).

## Example

Defaults (3 / 5):

```php{3,13,34}
<?php
class Grader {
    public function letter(int $score) {
        if ($score > 90) {
            return 'A';
        }
        if ($score > 75) {
            return 'B';
        }
        return 'C';
    }

    public function bucket(int $n) {
        switch ($n) {
            case 1: return 'one';
            case 2: return 'two';
            case 3: return 'three';
            case 4: return 'four';
            case 5: return 'five';
        }
        return 'many';
    }

    public function sorter() {
        return function ($a, $b) {
            if ($a < $b) { return -1; }
            if ($a > $b) { return 1; }
            return 0;
        };
    }

    public function widget() {
        return new class {
            public function kind($v) {
                if (is_int($v)) { return 'int'; }
                if (is_string($v)) { return 'string'; }
                return 'other';
            }
        };
    }
}

function plain($x) {
    if ($x) { return 1; }
    if (!$x) { return 2; }
    return 3;
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: 3 return statements in this method; try to funnel them into a single exit.</li>
<li>line 13: 6 return statements in this method; try to funnel them into a single exit.</li>
<li>line 34: 3 return statements in this method; try to funnel them into a single exit.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPLAIN_THRESHOLD` | int | 3 | Return count (inclusive) from which a warning is raised. |
| `SCREAM_THRESHOLD` | int | 5 | Return count (inclusive) from which an error is raised instead. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MultipleReturnStatements": {
      "enabled": true,
      "options": {
        "COMPLAIN_THRESHOLD": 3,
        "SCREAM_THRESHOLD": 5
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MultipleReturnStatements

/**
 * @noinspection MultipleReturnStatementsInspection
 */
```
